newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lower amid fund selling.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lower amid fund selling.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures settled broadly lower on fund-related selling tied to a lackluster technical performance, traders said.

Losses in wheat were exacerbated by the collapse in CBOT soybeans, which traders said was also triggered by fund selling. A lack of fundamentally supportive news added to the price erosion in KCBT wheat futures.
"Poor price action and technical trade ushered in fund selling... and a little exertion led by beans at the close allowed us to end within a penny of our daily lows," a KCBT trader said.

Rosenthal Collins, a commission house linked to fund activity, sold at least seven million May bushels. But Continental and Cargill Investors Services each purchased around two million May, traders said.
KCBT wheat settled three to 9-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with May down 9-1/2 cents at $4.05-1/2. July ended down 6-1/4 cents at $3.77-3/4.
